# Gather & Graze Yorkshire

> Grazing catering for gatherings in Hull and East Yorkshire.

Gather & Graze Yorkshire provides grazing tables, grazing platters and buffets. The business is registered in HU10 with East Riding of Yorkshire local authority and has a food hygiene rating of 5.

## Services

- Grazing tables
- Grazing platters
- Buffets

## Service area

Hull and East Riding of Yorkshire. Availability for a specific venue should be confirmed directly with the business.

## Contact

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gatherandgraze_yorkshire/
- Food hygiene record: https://ratings.food.gov.uk/business/en-GB/1906716

## Notes

This is an independent website concept. Current menus, dietary accommodations, prices and availability must be confirmed directly with Gather & Graze Yorkshire.
